<style>
:root{--navy:#0b1c2b;--navy2:#112b40;--blue:#0f6f9e;--orange:#e47716;--gold:#f5a623;--ice:#eaf4f8;--ink:#102333;--muted:#607383;--white:#fff;--line:#dce7ed;--shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(7,24,38,.13);--radius:24px}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#f6f9fb;overflow-x:hidden}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}.container{width:min(1180px,calc(100% - 40px));margin:auto}
.topbar{background:#071522;color:#dbe9f0;font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}.topbar .container{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:9px 0}.topbar span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}.topbar i{color:var(--gold)}
.nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(255,255,255,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(11,28,43,.08);transition:.25s}.nav.scrolled{box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(11,28,43,.1)}.nav-inner{height:78px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}
.brand img{width:240px;max-height:62px;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center}.nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;color:#304554}.nav-links a{position:relative;padding:29px 0}.nav-links a:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:20px;width:0;height:2px;background:var(--orange);transition:.25s}.nav-links a:hover:after{width:100%}.nav-cta{background:var(--orange);color:white!important;padding:13px 18px!important;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(228,119,22,.25)}.nav-cta:after{display:none}.menu-btn{display:none;border:0;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px}
.hero{position:relative;min-height:720px;display:flex;align-items:center;color:#fff;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(5,18,29,.96) 0%,rgba(5,18,29,.78) 43%,rgba(5,18,29,.27) 100%),url('data:image/png;base64,');background-size:cover;background-position:center}.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0;height:180px;background:linear-gradient(transparent,#f6f9fb);pointer-events:none}.mountain-fade{position:absolute;right:-8%;bottom:-40px;width:62%;height:360px;background:url('data:image/png;base64,') center/cover;filter:blur(7px);opacity:.16;mask-image:linear-gradient(to top,black,transparent);pointer-events:none}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:100px 0 150px;max-width:760px}.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(245,166,35,.14);border:1px solid rgba(245,166,35,.4);color:#ffd78c;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:999px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:900;font-size:11px}.hero h1{font-family:Manrope,Inter,sans-serif;font-size:clamp(44px,6.2vw,76px);line-height:.99;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin:22px 0 22px}.hero h1 span{color:#ffad3d}.hero p{font-size:18px;line-height:1.7;color:#d7e4ea;max-width:670px}.actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:30px}.btn{border:0;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:15px 21px;border-radius:13px;font-weight:900;transition:.22s}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.btn-primary{background:var(--orange);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(228,119,22,.3)}.btn-ghost{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}.trust-row{display:flex;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:35px;color:#dceaf0;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.trust-row span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.trust-row i{color:#ffb23e}
.stats{position:relative;z-index:5;margin-top:-65px}.stats-card{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}.stat{padding:27px 22px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid var(--line)}.stat:last-child{border:0}.stat strong{display:block;font-family:Manrope;font-size:31px;color:var(--navy)}.stat span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:700}
.section{padding:105px 0}.section-head{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto 55px;text-align:center}.kicker{color:var(--orange);font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}.section h2{font-family:Manrope;font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,52px);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--navy);margin:10px 0 15px}.section-head p{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75}
.service-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}.service{position:relative;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:29px;min-height:260px;box-shadow:0 8px 35px rgba(12,33,49,.06);transition:.25s;overflow:hidden}.service:hover{transform:translateY(-7px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:#c9dce6}.service:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:130px;height:130px;right:-55px;top:-55px;background:rgba(228,119,22,.08);border-radius:50%}.icon{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:16px;background:#fff0df;color:var(--orange);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px;margin-bottom:25px}.service h3{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--navy)}.service p{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;margin:0}.service .more{position:absolute;bottom:24px;color:var(--blue);font-size:12px;font-weight:900}
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:60px;align-items:center}.image-frame{position:relative}.image-frame img{width:100%;display:block;border-radius:28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);aspect-ratio:1.1;object-fit:cover}.image-frame .badge{position:absolute;left:-18px;bottom:25px;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(9,26,40,.2);display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}.badge i{font-size:22px;color:var(--orange)}.badge strong{display:block;color:var(--navy);font-size:14px}.badge small{color:var(--muted)}
.checks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin:25px 0}.check{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}.check i{color:var(--orange);margin-top:2px}
.county{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.county:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:url('data:image/png;base64,') center/cover;opacity:.09;filter:blur(2px)}.county .container{position:relative;z-index:1}.county-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:55px;align-items:center}.county h2{color:#fff}.county p{color:#bcd0dc}.areas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin-top:25px}.area{padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:999px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}.area:hover{background:rgba(245,166,35,.16);border-color:rgba(245,166,35,.4)}
.gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;grid-template-rows:250px 250px;gap:18px}.project{position:relative;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 10px 35px rgba(9,26,40,.12)}.project:first-child{grid-row:1/3}.project img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:.6s}.project:hover img{transform:scale(1.06)}.project:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:40% 0 0;background:linear-gradient(transparent,rgba(5,18,29,.9))}.project-info{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:22px;right:22px;bottom:20px;color:#fff}.project-info span{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#ffc16d;font-weight:900}.project-info h3{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:19px}
.process{background:#eef5f8}.process-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:15px}.step{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:25px}.step-num{font-family:Manrope;color:var(--orange);font-size:13px;font-weight:900}.step h3{font-size:17px;color:var(--navy);margin:11px 0 7px}.step p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted)}
.quote-wrap{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#edf5f8);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:30px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:35px}.quote-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px}.field{margin-bottom:17px}.field label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:7px}.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid #cfdee5;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px;outline:none;transition:.2s}.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--orange);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(228,119,22,.1)}input[type=range]{padding:0;accent-color:var(--orange)}.estimate{background:var(--navy);border-radius:22px;padding:28px;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;min-height:100%}.estimate .label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9fb5c1;font-weight:900}.estimate .price{font-family:Manrope;font-size:43px;color:#ffb54b;font-weight:900;margin:9px 0}.estimate p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;color:#a9bec9}.estimate-bar{height:7px;background:#244357;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;margin:15px 0}.estimate-bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:65%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--orange),#ffc45d);border-radius:10px;transition:.3s}
.faq-grid{max-width:850px;margin:auto}.faq{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff}.faq button{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border:0;background:transparent;padding:20px 3px;text-align:left;font-weight:900;color:var(--navy);cursor:pointer}.faq button i{transition:.2s;color:var(--orange)}.faq.open button i{transform:rotate(45deg)}.answer{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .3s ease;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.7}.faq.open .answer{max-height:180px}.answer div{padding:0 3px 20px}
.contact{background:#071522;color:#fff}.contact-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:55px}.contact h2{color:#fff}.contact p{color:#a9bec9;line-height:1.7}.contact-card{background:#0f2739;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);border-radius:24px;padding:27px}.contact-line{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;padding:15px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}.contact-line:last-child{border:0}.contact-line i{color:#ffb54b;width:18px;margin-top:2px}.contact-line strong{display:block;font-size:13px}.contact-line small{color:#91a8b5}
.footer{background:#050e16;color:#708694;padding:22px 0;font-size:11px}.footer .container{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}.float-wa{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:22px;width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;background:#25d366;color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:25px;z-index:90;box-shadow:0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25);animation:pulse 2.2s infinite}.to-top{position:fixed;right:22px;bottom:92px;width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:13px;border:1px solid #d5e1e6;background:#fff;color:var(--navy);z-index:89;display:none;box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(0,0,0,.12);cursor:pointer}.to-top.show{display:block}@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(37,211,102,.28),0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 13px rgba(37,211,102,0),0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:.7s}.reveal.visible{opacity:1;transform:none}.lightbox{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(3,12,19,.9);z-index:200;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:25px}.lightbox.show{display:flex}.lightbox img{max-width:min(1100px,95vw);max-height:86vh;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 30px 100px #000}.lightbox button{position:absolute;top:20px;right:25px;border:0;background:#fff;color:#102333;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;font-size:20px;cursor:pointer}
.mobile-menu{display:none}.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:25px;transform:translate(-50%,20px);background:#0b1c2b;color:#fff;padding:13px 17px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s;z-index:300;font-size:13px}.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:900px){.nav-links{display:none}.menu-btn{display:block}.mobile-menu{display:none;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 20px 18px}.mobile-menu.open{display:block}.mobile-menu a{display:block;padding:12px 0;font-weight:800;border-bottom:1px solid #edf2f5}.hero{min-height:650px}.stats-card{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.stat:nth-child(2){border-right:0}.stat:nth-child(-n+2){border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.service-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.split,.county-grid,.contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.process-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:260px 260px}.project:first-child{grid-row:auto}.quote-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:620px){.container{width:min(100% - 28px,1180px)}.topbar .container{justify-content:center}.topbar .hide-m{display:none}.brand img{width:190px}.nav-inner{height:68px}.hero{min-height:700px;background-position:58% center}.hero-content{padding:80px 0 135px}.hero h1{font-size:43px}.hero p{font-size:15px}.trust-row{gap:13px}.stats{margin-top:-45px}.stats-card{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.stat{padding:20px 10px}.stat strong{font-size:25px}.section{padding:78px 0}.service-grid,.process-grid,.gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gallery{grid-template-rows:300px 220px 220px}.project:first-child{grid-row:auto}.checks{grid-template-columns:1fr}.quote-wrap{padding:20px}.estimate .price{font-size:36px}.footer .container{flex-direction:column;text-align:center}.float-wa{right:16px;bottom:16px}}
</style>

<section class="section" id="servicios"><div class="container"><div class="section-head reveal"><div class="kicker">Lo que hacemos</div><h2>One company to take your project from start to finish.</h2><p>A more organized experience: planning, execution, communication, and finishes coordinated in one place.</p></div>
<div class="service-grid">
<article class="service reveal"><div class="icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-house"></i></div><h3>Custom Homes</h3><p>Design and construction of custom homes built around the property, lifestyle, and needs of each family.</p><div class="more">Residencial <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></div></article>
<article class="service reveal"><div class="icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-screwdriver-wrench"></i></div><h3>Remodelaciones</h3><p>Kitchens, bathrooms, basements, additions, and renovations that transform existing spaces without losing their character.</p><div class="more">Renovation <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></div></article>
<article class="service reveal"><div class="icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-building"></i></div><h3>Commercial Construction</h3><p>Commercial spaces and larger-scale projects with a professional presentation and results-focused execution.</p><div class="more">Commercial <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></div></article>
<article class="service reveal"><div class="icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-layer-group"></i></div><h3>Acabados & Exteriores</h3><p>Roofing, siding, stone, wood, exteriors, and architectural details that elevate durability and aesthetics.</p><div class="more">Exterior <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></div></article>
<article class="service reveal"><div class="icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-ruler-combined"></i></div><h3>Project Planning</h3><p>We define scope, priorities, and budget so you have greater clarity before work begins.</p><div class="more">Planning <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></div></article>
<article class="service reveal"><div class="icon"><i class="fa-solid fa-helmet-safety"></i></div><h3>Construction Coordination</h3><p>Progress tracking and clear communication to keep the project on track through every stage.</p><div class="more">Seguimiento <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></div></article>
</div></div></section>

A professional experience is built, too.</p><div class="checks"><div class="check"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Clear communication</div><div class="check"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Propuestas por alcance</div><div class="check"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Bilingual service</div><div class="check"><i class="fa-solid fa-check"></i> Enfoque en acabados</div></div><a class="btn btn-primary" href="#contacto">Discuss My Project <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></a></div>

<section class="section county"><div class="container county-grid"><div class="reveal"><div class="kicker">Nuestro terreno</div><h2>Especially designed for Utah County.</h2><p>From the heart of Utah Valley to its growing communities, we shape our experience around what makes this region special: mountains, families, businesses, and growth.</p><div class="areas"><span class="area">Provo</span><span class="area">Orem</span><span class="area">Lehi</span><span class="area">American Fork</span><span class="area">Pleasant Grove</span><span class="area">Lindon</span><span class="area">Spanish Fork</span><span class="area">Springville</span><span class="area">Payson</span><span class="area">Eagle Mountain</span><span class="area">Saratoga Springs</span><span class="area">Utah Valley</span></div></div>

</div></div></section>

<section class="section process" id="proceso"><div class="container"><div class="section-head reveal"><div class="kicker">How We Work</div><h2>De la idea a la llave.</h2><p>A simple process so you know what to expect from the first conversation.</p></div><div class="process-grid">
<div class="step reveal"><div class="step-num">01 / DESCUBRIR</div><h3>Tell Us Your Idea</h3><p>We discuss the space, location, goals, style, and priorities.</p></div>
<div class="step reveal"><div class="step-num">02 / DEFINIR</div><h3>Scope & Budget</h3><p>Ordenamos necesidades y creamos una base clara para tomar decisiones.</p></div>
<div class="step reveal"><div class="step-num">03 / CONSTRUIR</div><h3>Ejecutamos la obra</h3><p>We coordinate the stages and keep you informed about progress.</p></div>
<div class="step reveal"><div class="step-num">04 / ENTREGAR</div><h3>Detalles finales</h3><p>We review the result and focus attention on the finishing details.</p></div>
</div></div></section>

<section class="section" id="cotizador"><div class="container"><div class="section-head reveal"><div class="kicker">Estimator Pro</div><h2>Get a preliminary reference in less than a minute.</h2><p>Use this tool for an initial planning reference. It does not replace a formal proposal or an on-site visit.</p></div>
<div class="quote-wrap reveal"><div class="quote-grid"><div>
<div class="field"><label>PROJECT TYPE</label><select id="projectType"><option value="185">Custom Home</option><option value="95">Remodeling</option><option value="145">Commercial</option><option value="65">Exterior / Finishes</option></select></div>
<div class="field"><label>APPROXIMATE AREA: <span id="sqftLabel">1,500 sq ft</span></label><input id="sqft" type="range" min="500" max="5000" step="100" value="1500"></div>
<div class="field"><label>NIVEL DE ACABADO</label><select id="finish"><option value="1">Standard</option><option value="1.18">Premium</option><option value="1.38">Luxury</option></select></div>
<div class="field"><label>WHAT AREA?</label><select id="zone"><option value="1">Utah County / Utah Valley</option><option value="1.04">Wasatch Front / Surrounding Areas</option></select></div>

</div>
<div class="estimate"><div><div class="label">Preliminary Estimate</div><div class="price" id="price">$277,500</div><div class="estimate-bar"><i id="priceBar"></i></div><p>Approximate reference based on the selected project type, size, and finish level.</p></div><a class="btn btn-primary" href="#contacto">I Want a Real Quote <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-right"></i></a></div>
</div></div></div></section>

<section class="section" id="faq" style="padding-top:30px"><div class="container"><div class="section-head reveal"><div class="kicker">Frequently Asked Questions</div><h2>Lo que normalmente quieren saber antes de empezar.</h2></div><div class="faq-grid">
<div class="faq open"><button>Is the estimator a final quote?<i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i></button><div class="answer"><div>No. It is an interactive reference to help you understand project scale. Scope, site conditions, materials, and design decisions can change the final cost.</div></div></div>
<div class="faq"><button>Do you work on residential and commercial projects?<i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i></button><div class="answer"><div>Yes. We handle both types of projects, including custom homes, renovations, exteriors, and commercial construction.</div></div></div>
<div class="faq"><button>Can I request service in Spanish?<i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i></button><div class="answer"><div>Yes. Spanish-language service is available, with clear communication for clients throughout Utah County and Utah Valley.</div></div></div>
<div class="faq"><button>Can I send photos or details of my property?<i class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i></button><div class="answer"><div>Absolutely. You can describe your project in the request and use the contact information to continue the conversation.</div></div></div>

<button class="to-top" id="toTop" aria-label="Back to top"><i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up"></i></button>
<div class="lightbox" id="lightbox"><button id="closeLightbox"><i class="fa-solid fa-xmark"></i></button><img id="lightboxImg" alt="Proyecto ampliado"></div>
<div class="toast" id="toast">Estimate Updated</div>
<script>
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>document.querySelectorAll(s);
const navbar=$('#navbar'),toTop=$('#toTop');
window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{navbar.classList.toggle('scrolled',scrollY>10);toTop.classList.toggle('show',scrollY>500)});
toTop.onclick=()=>scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
$('#menuBtn').onclick=()=>$('#mobileMenu').classList.toggle('open');
$$('#mobileMenu a').forEach(a=>a.onclick=()=>$('#mobileMenu').classList.remove('open'));
const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting)e.target.classList.add('visible')}),{threshold:.12});
$$('.reveal').forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));
function animateCounts(){$$('[data-count]').forEach(el=>{const end=+el.dataset.count;let n=0;const step=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(end/35));const timer=setInterval(()=>{n=Math.min(end,n+step);el.textContent=n+(end===100?'%':'+');if(n>=end)clearInterval(timer)},35)})}
const statsObs=new IntersectionObserver(es=>{if(es[0].isIntersecting){animateCounts();statsObs.disconnect()}},{threshold:.4});statsObs.observe($('.stats-card'));
const sqft=$('#sqft'),label=$('#sqftLabel'),type=$('#projectType'),finish=$('#finish'),zone=$('#zone'),price=$('#price'),bar=$('#priceBar'),toast=$('#toast');
function calculate(){const area=+sqft.value,base=+type.value,mult=+finish.value,z=+zone.value,total=Math.round(area*base*mult*z/500)*500;label.textContent=area.toLocaleString()+' sq ft';price.textContent='$'+total.toLocaleString()+' USD';bar.style.width=Math.max(12,Math.min(100,(total/1200000)*100))+'%';toast.classList.add('show');setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),1300)}
sqft.oninput=calculate;type.onchange=calculate;finish.onchange=calculate;zone.onchange=calculate;$('#calcBtn').onclick=calculate;calculate();
$$('.faq button').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>btn.parentElement.classList.toggle('open')));
const lightbox=$('#lightbox'),lightboxImg=$('#lightboxImg');$$('.project').forEach(card=>card.addEventListener('click',()=>{lightboxImg.src=card.dataset.img;lightbox.classList.add('show')}));function closeBox(){lightbox.classList.remove('show');lightboxImg.src=''}$('#closeLightbox').onclick=closeBox;lightbox.onclick=e=>{if(e.target===lightbox)closeBox()};document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeBox()});
</script>
</body>
</html>
